title: GIVL: Improving Geographical Inclusivity of Vision-Language Models with Pre-Training Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance disparity (accuracy gaps) between Western and non-Western images on geo-diverse vision-and-language tasks such as GD-VCR, MaRVL, WIT Image-Text Retrieval, and the Dollar Street dataset.
Assessing the model's capacity to understand and reason about culturally specific visual concepts, customs, and knowledge using multicultural reasoning benchmarks like MaRVL and GD-VCR.
